# NODE

> NODE is a student and alumni collective founded in 2024 at the Institute for Advanced Architecture of Catalonia (IAAC) in Barcelona. We design and build open-source autonomous surface vehicles (ASVs) for marine data collection and environmental monitoring, and take them to international competitions and real field missions.

- Vessel: ASKET, an autonomous surface vessel with a 3D-printed hull, camera and LiDAR perception and a ROS 2 navigation stack.
- Values: innovation, curiosity, collaboration and openness.
- Contact: node.engineering.club@gmail.com

## Missions

- [Namibia 2026](https://www.nodeengineering.club/missions/namibia-2026): field mission in Lüderitz, Namibia, with Kelp Blue (7 November to 2 December 2026), measuring the kelp below the canopy.
- [Njord 2026](https://www.nodeengineering.club/missions/njord-2026): ASKET 2.0 at the Njord autonomous ship challenge in Trondheim, Norway, five places higher than in 2025.
- [Njord 2025](https://www.nodeengineering.club/missions/njord-2025): NODE's first Njord Challenge, where the team won the Team Spirit Award.
- [All missions](https://www.nodeengineering.club/missions)
